what: cover map of the 163 capped Stage-C records by the 1127 fallback balls
how: instrumented copy of the archived stageB.cpp; output byte-identical to data/fb1.bin

metric.E_formula: sqrt(1+ort)*R + 1e-7, R = parent's stored radius (=0.016 here)
metric.cover_criterion: cell covered iff eval(corner(u,w/2)) <= target, relationB::init/eval in stageB.cpp

caveat: the map is not in the archive; it is recovered here. Verify with coverage/relationB arithmetic, not by trust; 7 of 515243 cells are closed by the snap path rather than by a relation mark (see report section 5).
index_scheme: fine_index is the actual original batch/fine offset of each capped record, joined through (batch, ordinal within bad*.bin); batch_index remains the bad-file ordinal, not a full-batch position
provenance_repair: identifier-only join after the evidence audit; counters and parent/child lists retain their recovered order and content
